_doc: Global tuning knobs. Bible §3–§8. Godot and the wireframe read this file; change numbers here, not in code.

scale._note: Attributes and reserve maxes live on 0–300+. ~100 competent, ~150 elite, 200+ legendary.

reserves._note: Refill is a fraction of MAX per round, applied at end of RESOLVE. Wounds/states modify these.

focus._note: 100% unless hindered — the per-round attention budget

initiative._scale_note: D2.12 — 100-pt bar centred on 0. Ability deltas are irregular, roughly normal around ±8; big swings ±15–20; reveals/perfect counters can move 20+.

insight._note: 2 insight committed = +1 effective initiative on the 100-pt bar. Partial spend allowed.

action_budget._note: D2.7 — no action count. Queue until any required reserve is unaffordable.

damage._bypass_note: fraction of the guard the form ignores

variance._note: OPEN #0 — bible §1a. Default band 1.0–1.0 = deterministic. Applies to damage amount and initiative delta only.

stamina_conversion._note: stamina points per 1 point of the target; brace lasts one round
